name: io.github.tonyyang0504/highergov-mcp
description: HigherGov (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HIGHERGOV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: HigherGov API key (account admins: gear icon → API, per https://www.highergov.com/api-external/docs/).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HIGHERGOV_SEARCH_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional HigherGov SearchID of a saved opportunity search; the API has no keyword parameter, so filtering is done by a saved search.
